rows._role: PRIMARY -- the one band all five cells share. APPEND THIS ONE.
rows.label: FAIR-RULER RE-BASELINE (the D1 compute item): the 5-rung fair sub-ladder re-measured on the PRODUCTION EXECUTION -- rust backend, rules_profile fixed_v1 WITH the R9 env latch, curve125 champion leaf a36d2e15a3b3d71d, tie-arbiter OFF -- PLUS a bundled rules-attribution cell. SIX deck-paired cells on ONE band and the SAME 400 decks: fair PIMC candidate at k4x200=800 / k4x400=1600 / k4x688=2752 / k4x1376=5504 / k8x1376=11008 under fixed_v1, plus W2752 = the k4x688 cell re-run under rules_profile walled with R9 OFF; all six vs the FROZEN clairvoyant HeuristicMCTS(h800, c=3.0, leaf 42af12fce22e1a0f). PRIMARY = the within-band deck-paired rung SPACINGS (Delta1..Delta4 and SPAN = R_11008 - R_800) in pts/game; DELIVERABLE = the five re-based rung absolutes R_i; ATTRIBUTION = A = M_C2752 - M_W2752, the rules-only axis.
rows.notes: NOT YET CLAIMED -- drafted for the orchestrator to append verbatim once the pair is blind-committed (owner FUNDED 2026-08-23: 'I'm funding both', ~118.8 core-h, DESIGN.md Section 0.1). Seeds 142000000000..142000000399 (400 decks x 2 seatings = 800 games PER CELL, 4,800 games total across six cells; ONE deck set shared by ALL SIX). CRN across the six cells is DELIBERATE: per CL-068 the within-band deck-paired contrast is the ROBUST class, so the rung SPACINGS and the attribution statistic A -- not the absolutes -- are what this band is claimed to measure, and BOTH carry NO cross-band tax. The cross-era deltas against the July F5 fair_ruler_* cells (band 24e9, python backend, pre-fixed_v1 rules) are CROSS-BAND AND CROSS-ERA and carry the mandatory CL-068 2x sigma inflation (2-sigma MDE approximately 62 elo); they exist at only THREE of the five rungs (2752, 5504, 11008) because the 800 and 1600 rungs have no same-allocation post-fix comparator anywhere in the repo -- those two rungs produce NEW ABSOLUTES, filling the hole TRACK_D_PREP Section 3.5 named. The bundled W2752 cell resolves the RULES axis of that era bundle to approximately 24 elo within-band at one rung; the residual is a leftover, never an estimate of the band effect. This band is NOT to be pooled with 15e9 (CL-046 G1), 24e9 (F5 G2), or 141e9 (D2). The DESIGN Section 9 pilot uses a DISJOINT throwaway seed range, 142999999000..142999999007 (8 decks, run TWICE -- once fixed_v1, once walled, to prove the R9 inversion on a real record), which is discarded, never pooled, and never itself claimed as a row. Stated prior, recorded before game 1 (READ_RULE Section 6): G1 read +27.9/+61.4/+81.4/+149.3 at 800/1600/2752/5504 (rising, top increment biggest); G2 read +135.0 at 2752, +147.2 at 5504, +114.3 at 11008 k4x2752 and +123.0 at 11008 k8x1376 (already flat-to-bending at the top) -- so the house prior for this band is a large easily-resolved SPAN driven by the 800->2752 stretch with a flat-to-bending top. Once appended for real, band identity is load-bearing per CLAUDE.md and this band retires from confirmatory use once it has influenced a decision.

rows.notes: RESERVED, NOT LICENSED. Held for the DESIGN Section 6.3(c) n=800-decks/rung extension (approximately 238 core-h, 2x the funded cell) so a future 'just add n' ask does not have to re-plan a band.
